description: [Accra] Trotro and Shared Taxi GTFS Feed is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) feed describing trotro and shared taxi services in the Greater Accra Metropolitan Area, produced from the GUMAP Activity 003 field research campaign. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Accra, GTFS, Ghana. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
